dataset.source_timestamp_timezone: Broker-server wall time; importer's configured IC Markets GMT+2/GMT+3 seasonal conversion. The raw CSV itself has no timezone field.

dataset.source_limit_note: Importer reports the MT export 100k-row cap; this file's 100057 physical records include the export format's row behavior and may not contain older available history. The benchmark range must not be represented as the instrument's all-time history.

configuration.date_range: entire valid range in exact fingerprinted source dataset

blocking_requirements: Resolve verified XAUUSD broker instrument/tick metadata without guessing; current registry DB has no instrument registrations and node DB has no valid benchmark spec.
Create or identify the exact persistent default engulfing node and record its ID/version without replacing unrelated user data.
Benchmark before optimization and after optimization using identical copied/isolated test databases; do not write into the user's DATA databases merely to time a run.
